name: National Assembly
notes: 336 seats: 266 general, 60 reserved for women and 10 for non-Muslims. Who sits and their party are from the Assembly's own list of members (na.gov.pk); seats the list does not fill show as Vacant. Independent is how the Assembly lists members elected as independents, among them many backed by the PTI. Unlit seats mean nothing found, never opposition.

name: Senate
notes: 96 seats: 23 for each of the four provinces and 4 for the Islamabad Capital Territory. Who sits and their party are from the Senate's own list of members (senate.gov.pk); seats it does not list show as Vacant. Unlit seats mean nothing found, never opposition.
